1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea anual, trepadora, de hasta 5 m de altura, con tallo largo, ramoso, provisto de zarcillos, hojas alternas y flores amarillas, el fruto es comestible, oblongo, atravesado de verrugas, de color amarillo con semillas muy rojas; tiene propiedades medicinales. (Cucurbitaceae, Momordica charantia).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Annual climbing herbaceous plant, reaching up to 5 m in height, with a long, branching stem equipped with tendrils, alternate leaves and yellow flowers; the edible fruit is oblong, traversed by warts, of yellow color with very red seeds; it has medicinal properties. (Cucurbitaceae, Momordica charantia).
